data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Akas refers to the sky or the aether, the primal material that surrounds the universe. in_sanskrit.name: अकास
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The infinite, unmanifest, undifferentiated, and unchanging cosmic principle that is the source of all creation and is omnipresent. It is the first element of the Panchamahabhuta. Akas is the sky or the vast, open space above the earth. It is also referred to as the ether or the aether, the medium that fills the entire universe and allows all physical matter to exist.
